title: INFWAD – Mix alles (30 vragen)
description:
30 willekeurige vragen uit alle toetsen, inclusief de Vue- en Express-stickers, net als het echte tentamen: 8 HTML/CSS/JavaScript/TypeScript, 14 Vue en 8 Express. Nodig voor een 5,5: 20 van de 30 goed.

Wil je een nieuwe trekking? Draai `python nieuwe-mix-alles.py` in de map Toetsen/.

questions.title: Express 1 – Basics
questions.text: Node.js already has an `http` module to create a web server. What does Express add?
questions.explanation: With plain Node.js you check `req.url` and write headers yourself; Express does that for you.

options.text: A database and a login system
Simple functions for routing, sending responses and middleware, so you don't handle the low-level details yourself
The ability to run TypeScript without compiling
A visual editor for building web pages

questions.text: What is a primary advantage of Server-Side Rendering (SSR)?
questions.explanation: The server sends complete HTML, so search engines can read the content and the first display is fast. Smooth navigation without reloads is an SPA advantage.

options.text: It reduces the amount of work the server has to do

It is better for search engine optimization (SEO)
It gives the server more control over the content

questions.title: Vue 6 – Fetching data
questions.text:

```ts
products.value = await res.json()
```
The server responds with status 500. What happens?
questions.explanation: `fetch` only rejects on network failures. A 404 or 500 is still a response; `res.ok` is `false` for anything outside 200–299.

options.text: `fetch` throws an error, so the second line never runs
